page.overview:
What is Babari?

It was previously a part of the Prison Planet under the name Green Area. Babari is shown to be a lush green planet inhabited by the Babarians. In 1000 years, they are shown to form a tribe, discover fire, used trees to make clubs and have started using clothes.

They even create musical instruments and develop some kind of rudimentary writing. The planet was erased along with the rest of Universe 10 by Zeno and Future Zeno after Team Universe 10's defeat in the Tournament of Power.

It was later restored when the erased universes were restored thus explaining how it could still exist in Age 1779 (Age 1780 in the anime), as Gowasu and Zamasu's visit to that period was done before the events of the Tournament of Power as the visit occurred during the "Future" Trunks Saga.

A version of the planet was stolen by Fu and made a part of the Prison Planet. Numerous battles occurred here. In the game Babari was destroyed along with the rest of the Prison Planet, while in the manga the planet was sent back to Universe 10 by Oolong's wish.
